web_bg.wasm is compiled Rust. This list is every crate of the Cargo.lock file of the
Oxigraph repository at tag v0.5.13 (SHA-256 310850c9e15fb4ec8081e3aa6ac107b855cffe49ca257b47a63f04ff4d0580b9)
that the package oxigraph-js reaches through its dependencies, for every target and
every feature, so it holds more crates than the WebAssembly build links (build tools,
test tools and crates for other platforms among them). Each licence is the licence
expression crates.io states for that crate version (read 4 November 2026). Where an
expression offers MIT or Apache-2.0, this distribution takes the crate under that licence,
whose texts are LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE beside this file.

Format: crate version licence-expression
